name: notebook_ops
description: Query and manage the Open Notebook research knowledge base. Use for external knowledge: RFCs, papers, API docs, web articles — anything NOT in the codebase. Falls back gracefully with {"available":false} when Open Notebook is not running (base stack without overlay).

action.description: Operation to perform. list_notebooks: list all notebooks. create_notebook: create a new notebook by name. search: full-text or vector search across notebook content. add_note: save text content as a permanent note. add_source_url: ingest a URL (article, doc, RFC) into a notebook. poll_source_status: check async ingestion status of a source. get_source: retrieve full extracted text of a source. add_source_file: upload a local file (PDF, markdown, etc.) as a source. ask_notebook: grounded RAG query across notebook sources/notes. get_notebook: fetch notebook metadata including source/note IDs.

notebook_id.description: Target notebook ID (SurrealDB record ID, e.g. 'notebook:abc123'). Required for search, add_note, add_source_url, add_source_file, ask_notebook.

query.description: Search query string (for search action) or question (for ask_notebook action).

search_type.description: Search mode: vector=semantic similarity, text=keyword. Default: vector.

title.description: Title for add_note, add_source_url, or add_source_file actions.

content.description: Text content to save as a note (for add_note action).

url.description: URL to ingest as a source (for add_source_url action).

source_id.description: Source ID (e.g. 'source:abc123') for poll_source_status and get_source actions.

file_path.description: Path to file inside container (e.g. /opt/data/whitepaper.pdf) for add_source_file action.

strategy_model.description: Optional strategy model override for ask_notebook action.

answer_model.description: Optional answer model override for ask_notebook action.

final_answer_model.description: Optional final answer model override for ask_notebook action.
